response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as num_statuses, SUM(count) as total_telescopes FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.count, CAST(sc.count AS FLOAT) / CAST(ts.total_telescopes AS FLOAT) as share, 1.0 / CAST(ts.num_statuses AS FLOAT) as avg_share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_summary ts), above_avg AS (SELECT powerstatus, count, share, share - avg_share as distance_above FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(distance_above) as avg_distance_above FROM above_avg
